SHALLOW PRODUCTIVE AQUIFERS → tube-well irrigation permits multiple cropping

items: Article 350B creates the office of the Commissioner for Linguistic Minorities .
CAUTION: This is where cultural geography meets constitutional geography: language is not
only a social fact but also an administrative and rights-based category.
CAUTION: Linguistic states reduced some tensions after reorganisation, but did

groups.heading: DATA / INSTITUTION LIMIT
items: not erase minority pockets, border dialects or metropolitan multilingualism.

groups.heading: CONTEMPORARY PARALLEL
items: Linguistic families and scheduled languages are different classification levels.
Scheduled Areas (Fifth Schedule) and Sixth Schedule areas are not the same constitutional mechanism.
PVTG count = 75, across 18 states and 1 UT, as per Ministry of Tribal Affairs' July 2024 list.
NOT: Scheduled language = majority language in every district of its state - linguistic geography always has transition zones and minority belts.
